ranked_candidates.name: exploiter opponent CURRICULUM — 50% bots + a WR-ratcheted target
ranked_candidates.mechanism: v8's fork opened against a near-random target (temp 5.0) and hardened it only after clearing 55% WR per 500-game window, 16 times, while 50% of episodes faced scripted bots. That parks the fork in the max-advantage-signal zone for its whole length and imposes a second, non-self-referential objective per pinned team. The R2 fork faces one full-strength near-mirror as SOLE opponent from step 0: WR ~0.5 by construction, small symmetric advantages, update dominated by entropy/value/drift.
evidence_for: cli_args.exploiter_keep_bots True(v8)/False(ALL gen incl. tick-1 tocks)
exploiter_temp_state.json {temp:1.0,n_ratchets:16} in all 3 v8 forks, absent in every gen run
forensics: fork logit-shift 231-257 vs no-fork control 259; on-slice top-1 0.692-0.768 vs off-slice 0.709-0.742 (no differentiation)
evidence_against: R2 admission rows show a real +11.65pp mean extraction, so the fork did learn something — the claim is about the KIND of content, not its existence
ranked_candidates.discriminator: re-run ONE R2 fork (3M, ~2 GPU-h) adding --exploiter-keep-bots --exploiter-bot-fraction 0.5 --bot-weights aggressive_v2=3,heuristic2=3 --heuristic-floor 0.2 --exploiter-temp-start 5.0 --exploiter-temp-mode ratchet, then re-run the forensics on/off-slice top-1 split (CPU, scripts exist). NO FOLD NEEDED. Prediction: on-slice agreement drops BELOW off-slice (the v8 signature). 2-arm version (bots-only vs ratchet-only) separates the halves for 4 GPU-h.

ranked_candidates.name: FOLD duration and on-slice gradient DENSITY
ranked_candidates.mechanism: 14.92M vs 3.00M fold steps; effective batch 32768 vs 4096; team_block_episodes 64 vs 1. On-pin distilled transitions differ ~5x (6.0M vs 1.2M) and optimizer steps 8x. Team-blocking gives temporally coherent per-team gradient; block=1 across 48 envs makes the on-pin rows a thin constantly-reshuffled sample of 9 conditions — the worst case for learning a CONDITIONAL mapping, the same shape as this project's own FiLM sample-starvation finding that the flag was built to counter.
evidence_against: rev-3 already tests +4.5M fold length and dose 0.35, addressing the duration leg
ranked_candidates.discriminator: one 3M fold arm identical to R2ACTION except --team-block-episodes 64 --grad-accum-steps 16. ~2 GPU-h, reads on the existing 9-team piloting meter. The ONLY untested factor on this axis.

ranked_candidates.name: POINTER HEAD — copying a decision now requires moving the shared trunk
ranked_candidates.mechanism: v8's flat Linear(512,11) gave every action logit an independent 512-dim row, so a teacher's preference could be written LOCALLY with zero representation cost. The pointer head has NO per-action parameters: move_score/switch_score/struggle_score are one Linear(H,1) each shared across all candidates of their family, so the only route to a RELATIVE preference change is through entity tokens (team_transformer, trunk) or latent_pi (mlp_extractor, trunk). Distillation is therefore structurally a representation edit. Predicts BOTH the all-or-nothing global rank collapse (pi_features 21.87->12.50 at any nonzero coef) and the failure to differentiate on-slice, from one cause.
evidence_for: per-parameter the gen head moved LESS (1.8% of d2 on 9x the params vs 0.7% on 1x)
the rank collapse is a SWITCH, not a dose response
evidence_against: forensics function-level inter-fork cosine is FLAT across eras (+0.375 v8 vs +0.383 gen)

v8's fork delta was TRUNK-HEAVY (G2 0.47 vs gen 0.28; G2+G5 = 0.76 of d2) — v8 renovated the trunk MORE and still folded cleanly, which falsifies 'the flat head let v8 keep changes local' as a description of the FORK; the surviving form is about the FOLD
ranked_candidates.discriminator: PARAMETER-GROUP GRAFTING, pure CPU, read-only, hours: graft ONLY R2ACTION's G6 (pointer_head + value_net) onto rev-1 and measure teacher-agreement recovery on recorded on-slice states; then only G2+G5; then both. Mirror on v8 (graft ai_v8_14's action_net onto ai_v8_04). Causal test is dearer: bolt a zero-init residual Linear(latent_pi,11) beside the pointer head (byte-identical at init) and re-run one fold arm (~1 day + 2 GPU-h).

ranked_candidates.name: HEADROOM — v8 baseline 0.438 vs current ~0.575
ranked_candidates.mechanism: A fold's yield is bounded by what there is to take. v8 had ~0.28 of win rate available on teams its parent was actively bad at; rev-1 has ~0.12. A '96% conversion' and a '13% conversion' against denominators differing 2.3x are not comparable. Worse, the KIND of content differs: lifting a losing policy to 0.71 is coarse and transferable as a global shift; lifting 0.575 to 0.69 is fine-grained conditional play, which a global shift cannot carry — closing the loop with the differentiation finding.
evidence_against: explains a RATIO difference, not the differentiation finding — undifferentiated teachers is not a headroom fact
ranked_candidates.discriminator: free first pass: regress conversion on baseline across every archived fold (ai_v8_14, tick-1, fdA/B/C/E, G1/G2, R2ACTION/TOPK/KL) using each fold's own recorded baseline piloting (n~10, confounded, but prices the term). Cleaner: rev-3 already picks coverage teams by WORST rev-1 piloting — piggyback a per-team conversion-vs-baseline readout at zero extra cost.

ranked_candidates.name: TEACHERS IN THE OPPONENT MIX + a richer fold ecology
ranked_candidates.mechanism: v8's fold put the 3 teachers in the opponent mix at 0.35 share with PFSP; a specialist stable opponent pilots its OWN pinned team. So on exactly the teams the KL taught, the student (i) visited states in the teacher's own region on-policy — the DAgger argument — and (ii) had an RL gradient pointing the same way as the KL. The R2 folds have no stable opponents at all, plus no pfsp_scale, no pool_spread, 5 sentinels not 10, team_pfsp off not onesided, no bot floor.
evidence_for: cli_args stable_opponents / share 0.35 / stable_opponent_pfsp True in ai_v8_14 vs None/0.20/False in every R2 fold
fdC tested ecology WITHOUT a distill term; tick-1 tested it with 3M UNDIFFERENTIATED teachers — neither tests the interaction the v8 arc ran
evidence_against: fdC (coef 0.0, ecology ON at 0.35) measured -1.2pp n.s. -> 'ecology EXONERATED'
tick-1 DID carry stable-opponents + 0.35 + pfsp and was graded INFERIOR on three meters
ranked_candidates.discriminator: it is an INTERACTION and cannot be tested cheaply before C1 lands. Make it the second arm of the C1 experiment: if a curriculum-trained fork differentiates, fold it BOTH with and without --stable-opponents <teachers> --stable-opponent-selfplay-share 0.35 --stable-opponent-pfsp. ~2 extra GPU-h on top of C1.

ranked_candidates.name: the fold recipe was never literally replicated — FitNets 0.5 vs v8's 0.0
ranked_candidates.mechanism: --distill-value-feat-coef pulls the student's 128-dim value_pooled toward each teacher's by cosine on the SAME on-pin rows the policy KL fires on — a shared-trunk pull exactly where the rank collapse was observed. R2KL carries the 'this is v8's channel' claim and differs from ai_v8_14 by this one live term.
evidence_for: cli_args.distill_value_feat_coef 0.0 (ai_v8_14) vs 0.5 (every gen fold incl. tick-1)
evidence_against: ledger 4452 estimates FitNets alignment 0.995 at hour one => ~0 gradient
the Phase-B ruling adopting 0.5 is explicit and reasoned
BUT ledger 4340 records this same metric previously read INVERTED, so record confidence is low
ranked_candidates.discriminator: read distill/*_value_feat_cos out of the R2 arms' TensorBoard — MINUTES, CPU, no new run. cos >= 0.99 throughout => C6 dies. Otherwise one 3M arm at --distill-value-feat-coef 0.0 (~2 GPU-h) settles it AND delivers the literal v8 replication never yet run.

ranked_candidates.name: OPTIMIZER regime — ~4x the lr at 1/4 the effective batch
ranked_candidates.mechanism: lr 3e-4 vs 7e-5, clip 0.15 vs 0.10, n_epochs 10 vs 7, effective batch 16384/4096 vs 32768. More UNDIRECTED movement per unit of directed signal — which is the forensics' drift-anchor observation: R2CTRL (verified no-fork) drifts KL 0.3245, INSIDE the forks' 0.269-0.349. If drift equals content in size, no fold can separate them.
evidence_for: global rel-Frobenius 0.026 (gen) vs 0.021 (v8) at a 3-4% SHORTER fork
evidence_against: rel-Frobenius differs only 1.23x despite a 4.3x lr gap
the parents differ in maturity, which independently sets how far a step moves the function
ranked_candidates.discriminator: one 3M fork at --lr 7e-5 --clip-range 0.10 --n-epochs 7 --grad-accum-steps 16, then fork-vs-CTRL logit-shift norm and the on/off-slice split (CPU scripts exist). Run C1 first or factor them — a joint arm cannot attribute.

ranked_candidates.name: no per-team CONDITIONING path exists in the current architecture
ranked_candidates.mechanism: v8 carried zarch FiLM (z-dim 32, --zarch-film heads, recon 1.0, vicreg 0.1, --film-grad-accum-steps 6) and the D1 ledger row reports 'far-z FiLM range +70%' for the fold itself — the fold USED the conditioning path. The current architecture has none. A conditional teacher can only be copied if the student can represent the condition.
evidence_for: model_config zarch_* present in v8, absent in gen
evidence_against: LUT result: a free per-team code did NOT close the N=20 gap (+0.024, CI [-0.016,+0.064])
ranked_candidates.discriminator: none cheap; the existing null makes it poor value. Recorded so the era diff is complete and so D1's FiLM figure is not mistaken for something the current arch could reproduce.

ranked_candidates.name: slice BREADTH — 23 teams total / 3-10 per teacher vs 2
ranked_candidates.mechanism: A 2-team pin can be satisfied by a global shift; a 10-team pin cannot, so breadth FORCES team-conditional structure into the teacher.
evidence_for: the differentiation contrast is exactly 23-team-total vs 2-team teachers
evidence_against: the admission table is flat across the fleet (mean +0.1165, sd 0.0098, five different team pairs) — extraction SIZE does not track breadth
tock-1a's 4 teams showed no differentiation gain
ranked_candidates.discriminator: Probe A, already dispatched. CAVEAT FOR ITS READER: every rung of the archive's breadth ladder except the 23 is a gen-era fork with NO bots and NO temperature ratchet (C1), so a FLAT result across 2->9 does not distinguish 'breadth doesn't matter' from 'the gen regime suppresses differentiation at every breadth'.

not_explained_by_this_diff: the distillation channel is byte-identical across eras — nothing about the KL implementation regressed
forward (mass-covering) KL direction and the total absence of temperature are properties of BOTH eras, so they cannot be a difference (they may still be a shared defect — Probe D's question)
belief_grad_mode=shaping, PopArt, distill_team_bias 0.4, on-policy state sourcing, PPO beside the distill loss, self_play off in forks, team_pfsp off in forks are the SAME in both eras
the parents differ 11x in maturity and 2.3x in headroom; no dimensionless statistic removes that, so every candidate is a contributing term, not a sole cause
